entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess it's pretty hard to see your own[n]father turned into something like that...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: No, that's not it...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was just thinking how glad I am[n]that I met the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If not, I don't think I would have been[n]able to stand up to my father.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can't believe he thought of his own[n]daughter as just a machine...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: In Kamoshida's cognition, I was just[n]some kind of doll.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think Haru's situation was even more[n]heartbreaking, though...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: After Father passed away, I got to talk[n]with all the managers and executives.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...None of them were like robots.[n]They were all just ordinary people.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I have no idea what they're going[n]through, and I'm sure there'll be issues[n]that the company needs to work out...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I was still a little relieved.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It sounds like you've got a healthy[n]approach to the situation.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That part of you's always impressed me,[n]Haru.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thanks. That's nice to hear from you,[n]Mako-chan.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Sumire-chan, you learned about the[n]Metaverse around the same time as[n]my joining the Phantom Thieves, right?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: That's right—or at least that's what[n]I've been told, anyway.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I know I was going through a lot myself,[n]but, um... Haru-senpai...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What's done is done... or so I wish[n]I could say. I'm getting there, though.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Now that I've become close with[n]everyone else, I have the strength[n]to keep moving forward.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: And that includes you, Sumire-chan.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Haru-senpai...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm so glad to hear it. Let's do our[n]best together!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Whoa, this looks like some kinda[n]shady underground society.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Are those all bad guys?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Hmm, I'm not certain...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Even in such an organization, you can't[n]know for sure that every member has[n]malicious intent.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Circumstances can sometimes lead[n]individuals into situations that conflict[n]with their moral codes.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hmm...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: If you don't wanna do something, then[n]why don't you just say so? Adults are[n]so complicated.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I didn't specialize in mental care, but I[n]know plenty of people today are suffering[n]from work-related mental health issues.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I wouldn't say a job shouldn't take effort,[n]but nobody should get turned into a[n]shell of a person over it, either.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That wouldn't be an issue if we could[n]identify the problem before it grew[n]overwhelming, but it's not a simple task...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: This just represents one of society's[n]problems—its unrelenting harshness...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...and that's what led me to my decision!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? What decision?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm not gonna just live life as some cog[n]in society! I'm gonna become someone[n]who matters—and change this world!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wow, look at Mishima, tryin' to shed his[n]NPC status! So, what're you gonna do?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: My next decision is to figure that out!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sooo, you have no clue...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We've seen all kinds o' stuff since we[n]founded the Phantom Thieves, but[n]man, a battle with a time limit? Phew...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, plus all those enemies that would[n]charge us and self-destruct? So hectic...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You can throw scumbags at us all day,[n]but I never want to fight someone who's[n]being forced to do it ever again.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I suppose this applies to Kaneshiro as[n]well, but—can money alone really warp[n]a person's heart this severely?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Generally speaking, I don't think so...[n]perhaps money facilitates such warping[n]in humans?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A lack of money certainly doesn't[n]equate a lack of happiness, though.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yup! Inari's the expert there!
